transferable_principle: Use two-pane evidence on large screens and keep the hinge clear; verify on a real or remote Galaxy device.
fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch. Current device behavior still requires testing.

material_claim: Apple recommends adaptable system-aware color, sufficient contrast, and non-color communication.

material_claim: Motion should communicate relationships and feedback while respecting reduced-motion preferences.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch.

material_claim: Audio behavior must respect context, user control, and system expectations.

material_claim: Live Activities are glanceable, bounded presentations with system-controlled contexts and privacy considerations.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch. This is a reference, not permission to copy its interface.

material_claim: WCAG 2.2 requires at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text except stated exceptions.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch. Vendor claims do not establish effectiveness.

material_claim: Spotify describes finite personalized stories, revisit controls, and explicit share cards.

fallback_or_limitation: Exa discovery and full-text fetch. Product claims do not establish retention or preference.
